Evidence: Steps 2-10 involve repeated WebSurfer calls and Planner instructions focusing on "Cypress Cupressus Britannica" and similar queries, with no new information gathered beyond the initial search.

The Subtask Name: Web Search for Ajuga Taxonomy
Step Range: 11-21
The Oracle: The agents continue to cycle through searches for Ajuga and Cupressus using Britannica and POWO, repeating the same queries and instructions without reaching a final conclusion or synthesizing the answer.
Evidence: Steps 11-21 show repeated WebSurfer calls for "Ajuga genus Britannica", "Cupressus Britannica", and "Plants of the World Online", with the Planner reiterating the same instructions, indicating a failure to terminate the search loop.
